descriptions.text: Adept’s fountain pen. The most basic of all the calligrapher’s implements. How much grief, how much suffering has been caused by one of these things? Yet, how much joy? That whole saying, the pen is mightier than the sword, is one of the few human world metaphors that I believe to be universally true, especially since swords are terrible, barbaric weapons. This is the most versatile item anyone can own. What will you do with it? Write a book that changes everything? …

recap.text: Milk tells Carl that every recipe she wrote after changing inks faded away. She hands him a wineskin of Stayfast Ink and an Adept's fountain pen, the most basic calligrapher's implement and, by the System's reckoning, the most versatile item anyone can own. Donut mentions Carl's goblin and chicken recipes, and Milk replies that he also has the Voodoo one they all have: whatever he writes in it goes to everyone who already holds it.

beats.headline: Something else from Milk
beats.text: Milk has told Carl about the book she once wrote her recipes in, and how all she wrote after she changed inks faded and disappeared. She hands him a wineskin of Stayfast Ink, and then something else: a fountain pen. Adept's fountain pen, the most basic of all the calligrapher's implements, and by the System's reckoning the most versatile item anyone can own. Carl has a recipe book, says Donut, with goblin and chicken recipes. I heard, says Milk. He also has another book, one they all have: the Book of Voodoo. Anything he writes in it will be given to everybody who already has it.
beats.gist: Milk gives Carl a wineskin of Stayfast Ink and Adept's fountain pen.
